notes.title: Shroomer Demo update 0.3.2
notes.notes:
New

Implemented herb cutting, added different harvestable herbs, added sickle

Implemented drying of herbs, food and shrooms

Added a new mushroom with a unique mechanic 

Added bubbles to cooking pot when boiling

Added vignette when walking and running to reduce motion sickness

Added rare sound effects in forest area at night

On android SpaceWarp is now turned on during loading to reduce lag

Important objects now have their dedicated sockets on player or basket


[hr][/hr]


Changed

When scaring birds they now directly fly away from player and then find suitable spot to land

Papyrus texture so the text area blends better with rest of the model

Quest time limits are now set dynamically on quest start

Sounds for pockets and socketing objects


[hr][/hr]


Fixed bugs

Fixed bug where pillow could fall through the map when player was far away

Fixed bug where inventory freeze effect would play on quest accept

Fixed bug where sometimes finished quest couldn’t be grabbed from basket top

Fixed that potion would spill when drinking, causing much faster depletion

Fixed foveated rendering setting not saving correctly on PCVR

Fixed physics materials on knife so now they make correct sounds and effects

And few minor bugs

notes.title: Shroomer Demo Update 0.2.6
notes.notes:
New

Added inventory mechanics to boxes, bowls, and other objects

Introduced mold and rot mechanics for mushrooms, which can block or enable quest delivery depending on requirements

Added slugs to some mushrooms that block quest delivery

Added new ambient and event sounds throughout the forest

Added new interactable objects across the scene

Added new secrets

Implemented liquid transfer and blending mechanics — any container with liquids can now be spilled and mixed

Added a way to fill the cooking pot in the loading room

Added new detailing to the forest area

Added butterfly variations

Added variations of bugs and other fauna to mushrooms


[hr][/hr]


Changed

Ladders can now be dismounted using teleport

Delivery portal now features new VFX and SFX

Pre-cut mushrooms are now edible and can be cooked

Birch tree/wood gradient 




[hr][/hr]


Fixed

Fixed bug where incorrect items weren’t returned properly at the delivery portal

Added missing Czech localization in the graphics settings

Fixed an error caused by socketing the money pouch

Fixed issue where the effect on a magic mushroom wouldn’t play

Fixed bug where the tree tapper effect would play even if the bottle wasn’t filling up

Money duplication with fast grabbing

Parus bird could fly through portal with delivered items resulting in item being stuck in portal

Watertap particles would play at game start

Water footstep sounds

Spider yoyo effect
